components: Every request is attributed to its owning tenant.
Aggregate rate and concurrency protect shared service capacity.
Users and workloads draw from the common allowance.
Optional sub-limits prevent one member from consuming the tenant budget.
Excess tenant traffic is queued, degraded, or rejected.
